9/11 – We Don't Believe You

Terror Attacks of September 11, 2001
Photos: AP (6), Bloomberg

FOCUS MONEY 2/2010
Page 74–77

This is a Grok translation of my viral print article from 2010. 

More and more people doubt the official theory of September 11 – including more than 400 scientists

It is his last fight, but perhaps his most important one. Jesse Ventura fought in Vietnam in the UDT (Under Water Demolition Team), a unit that carried out explosive attacks under water and was later incorporated into the famous Navy SEALs. Later, he wrestled with competitors as a professional wrestler until he entered the political arena. From 1999 to 2003, Ventura was governor of the U.S. state of Minnesota. Today, he is stunned that during his time as governor, he believed the official story of the September 11 terrorist attacks, even though he already had profound experiences with explosives. "I kicked myself that no light dawned on me when it happened back then. But I was so shocked that this thing could happen at all that I apologize for not being more attentive at the time," he told U.S. radio host Alex Jones. Today, he is fighting for the truth with a specially produced series for the cable channel TruTV. The title: "Conspiracy Theory."

Growing Doubt. Like Jesse Ventura, more and more people in the U.S. are coming to this realization. According to a series of polls, the majority of Americans no longer believe the official theory that Islamist terrorists under the leadership of Osama bin Laden were responsible for the attacks. According to the last major survey by Zogby, a leading opinion research institute, from August 2007, for example, 67 percent of those surveyed said that the 9/11 Commission should also have investigated the collapse of World Trade Center 7 (WTC 7). The fact that it did not fuels their doubts. The website https://t.co/ahnYgnZURi now lists around 2,000 university professors, military personnel, pilots, police officers, architects, engineers, physicists, intelligence experts, judges, and celebrities—400 scientists alone—without taking a position itself. Italy's former president Francesco Cossiga and Nobel Prize winner writer Dario Fo also doubt George W. Bush's official theory. Have these people, who are otherwise credited with high credibility and to whom human lives are often entrusted, all gone mad?

What distinguishes these concerned citizens from those who dismiss everyone who doesn't believe the official version as crazy conspiracy theorists? They have engaged with the facts that are hardly mentioned in the traditional media.

Newton's Third Law. "Mass always takes the path of least resistance," the famous physicist recognized more than 300 years ago. It is not even possible to compress a matchstick from top to bottom. It buckles at the spot where it first gives way. Similar to how a tree falls to the side when a notch is cut into it with an axe. That means: Wherever the steel may have given way first due to the plane's impact, the building should have fallen to that side. "Ask yourself a simple question: Why did the lower block of the building offer no resistance at all to the much smaller upper part?" asks architect Richard Gage. "The towers accelerated without interruption at free-fall speed, softly and symmetrically, as if the lower 90 floors didn't exist at all. The only way to achieve that is a controlled demolition." The government agency NIST, responsible for investigating the collapses, did not even consider the possibility of a controlled demolition. The curious justification: Controlled demolitions usually start from the bottom in the basement. However, janitor William Rodriguez witnessed exactly such demolitions in the lower floors on several occasions, including in Jesse Ventura's series.

Ventura himself only changed his mind when his son persuaded him to watch the film Loose Change, which is said to have been viewed over 100 million times on the web by now. Films like Zero by Italian Member of the European Parliament Giulietto Chiesa or 911 Mysteries have since been shown on ORF or Vox as well. Ventura's series Conspiracy Theory airs on Ted Turner's cable channel TruTV. Hollywood producer Aaron Russo (Trading Places) also addressed the backgrounds of 9/11 in his documentary America: From Freedom to Fascism. All films are available on Google Video.

Architects & Engineers for 9/11 Truth. Architect Richard Gage also disputes that fire caused the three skyscrapers to collapse: "Fires in skyscrapers have never caused steel buildings to collapse." Gage has been an architect for twenty years and has built numerous fireproof steel buildings in that time. Most recently, he worked on a 400-million-euro project that incorporated 1,200 tons of steel. He founded the movement Architects & Engineers for 9/11 Truth (https://t.co/tThywFn9Nb), which now has nearly a thousand architects and engineers, plus 5,000 other supporters. "The collapse of the Twin Towers and World Trade Center 7 meets all criteria for a controlled demolition, but not a single criterion for a collapse due to fire," explains Gage (see box on left).

He also points to the numerous pieces of evidence for demolitions. "We found tons of molten steel. Steel only melts at 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit; kerosene and office fires reach a maximum of 1,400, perhaps 1,600 degrees Fahrenheit." According to Gage, the probability that the fires damaged all load-bearing parts exactly simultaneously is zero. But even if the probability were, say, ten percent, consider that three buildings collapsed symmetrically into themselves that day. The probability for that happening three times on the same day would then be 0.1 (ten percent) × 0.1 × 0.1 × 100, or 0.1 percent. In other words: Even if one estimates the chances for such an event relatively high, the probability that the official theory is correct is 1 in 1,000. And those are still optimistic assumptions.

The Twin Towers
Controlled Demolitions?
WTC Collapses: Explosive Clouds

Criteria for Fire
Three criteria would at least have had to be met if the building collapsed due to fire:
Slow start with large visible deformations
Asymmetric collapse along the path of least resistance
Proof of temperatures that could weaken steel

Evidence for Demolitions
According to the Architects' Association https://t.co/tThywFn9Nb, all criteria for a controlled demolition were met:
Destruction follows the path of greatest resistance. Debris parts are symmetrically distributed.
Extremely fast start of destruction (rapid onset)
Over 100 witnesses reported explosions and light flashes. Several tons of heavy steel parts flew out vertically. 90,000 tons of metal and concrete were pulverized in the air. Very large, expanding pyroclastic clouds (see right). No pancake-like stacking of floors. Isolated horizontal explosions 20 to 40 floors lower. Molten steel and explosive Thermite found.

And: No steel high-rise has ever collapsed due to fire.
Image evidence: Diagonally cut steel beams, molten steel—as is usual in demolitions.

World Trade Center 7
Error in the Report
WTC 7 Collapse: Without plane impact, the building collapses at free-fall speed.

World Trade Center 7, a 47-story, well-secured steel building housing the CIA and Secret Service, collapsed about seven hours after the Twin Towers, even though no plane had crashed into it. The official "9/11 Commission Report" doesn't mention the building at all. However, numerous inquiries from members of the 9/11 truth movement prompted the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), a federal agency, to issue a study seven years after the collapse. The biggest puzzle the experts had to solve was that the building collapsed practically at free-fall speed. Normally, the individual floors provide resistance, so the building would have had to collapse much more slowly. According to the official account, falling debris from the Twin Towers damaged the building. However, WTC 7 is about a soccer field away, and no significant damage is visible in the footage. Moreover, the building should then have fallen toward the side of the damage, not into its own foundation. The solution NIST eventually provided led to outbursts ranging from laughter to horror in the truth movement. "Ridiculous," "total bullshit"—those were still the politest comments. The official version goes like this: Internally, the building would have collapsed for 30 minutes already, and in the end, the outer shell came down at free-fall speed—an unprecedented event. Scientists in the truther community wrote page-long studies questioning every detail of the official study. None of these questions has been answered to date; the complete data from the computer model used remains secret. Just one example of the inconsistencies in the NIST report: Temperatures for 5:30 and 6:00 p.m. are displayed on the floors. But the building collapsed at 5:21 p.m.

Catholic: "So how does Luther construct the parallelism between Christ's priesthood and Melchizedek's priesthood?" 

Lutheran: "They parallel each other merely and simply in that both have the signification of eternality, as opposed to temporality." 

Catholic: "The order of Aaron, did it have more to it than simply temporality?"

Lutheran: "Of course, there were many prescriptions for service, sacrifices, victims, schedules, rituals, etc. etc." 

Catholic: "Ok... so you don't think there is more to the order of Melchizedek than simply eternality?"

text:
The Joyful Mysteries of the Rosary: The Visitation: A Journey of Grace and Blessing

In the heart of the Gospel of Luke, nestled between the Annunciation and the Nativity, lies a profound narrative that encapsulates the essence of grace and blessing in the Christian life: the Visitation. This event, where the Blessed Virgin Mary visits her cousin Elizabeth, is not merely a tale of familial affection but a powerful testament to the workings of divine grace. As we delve into this journey of grace and blessing, we find a model for our own spiritual lives, a blueprint for how we can embody the virtues of faith, humility, and charity.

The Visitation, as recounted in Luke 1:39-56, begins with Mary's prompt response to the angel Gabriel's announcement that her cousin Elizabeth, in her old age, is also with child. Mary's immediate action to travel to the hill country of Judea is a testament to her faith and her readiness to serve. This journey is not just a physical one but a spiritual pilgrimage, where grace is both received and bestowed. The Council of Trent, in its sixth session, emphasizes the role of grace in the life of the believer, stating, "If anyone says that without the predisposing inspiration of the Holy Ghost and without His help, man can believe, hope, love, or be repentant as he ought, so that the grace of justification may be bestowed upon him, let him be anathema" (Session 6, Canon 3). Mary's journey to Elizabeth is a vivid illustration of this grace at work, guiding and empowering her actions.

Upon arriving at Elizabeth's home, Mary's greeting is met with a profound response. Elizabeth, filled with the Holy Spirit, exclaims, "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!" (Luke 1:42). This blessing is not only a recognition of Mary's role as the Mother of God but also an acknowledgment of the grace that surrounds her. The Catechism of the Catholic Church elaborates on this, stating, "Mary's response, 'Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it done to me according to your word,' was the most perfect expression of her faith and the most perfect act of her obedience" (CCC 148). Mary's humility and obedience are the conduits through which grace flows, blessing not only her but all of humanity.

The Visitation also highlights the communal aspect of grace. When Mary arrives, the child in Elizabeth's womb, John the Baptist, leaps for joy. This moment underscores the interconnectedness of the Christian community, where the grace received by one can inspire and uplift others. Saint Augustine, in his reflections on this event, writes, "The Lord is present, and wherever the Lord is, there is grace." This communal dimension of grace is further emphasized in the writings of Saint Thomas Aquinas, who states, "Grace is a participation in the divine nature, and thus it is a gift that transforms and elevates the human person" (Summa Theologica, I-II, Q. 110, A. 3). The Visitation, therefore, serves as a reminder that grace is not a solitary experience but one that is meant to be shared and celebrated within the community of believers.

The theological insights from the Council of Trent also shed light on the role of grace in the life of the believer. The Council affirms that "justification... is not remission of sins merely, but also the sanctification and renewal of the inward man, through the voluntary reception of the grace, and of the gifts, whereby man of unjust becomes just, and of an enemy a friend" (Session 6, Chapter 7). Mary's journey to Elizabeth is a manifestation of this transformative power of grace. Her actions, inspired by the Holy Spirit, bring about a renewal and sanctification that extends beyond herself to her cousin and the child in her womb.

In the context of today's world, the Visitation remains a powerful model for how we can live out our faith. Pope Francis, in his apostolic exhortation Evangelii Gaudium, speaks of the joy of the Gospel, saying, "The joy of the Gospel fills the hearts and lives of all who encounter Jesus. Those who accept his offer of salvation are set free from sin, sorrow, inner emptiness, and loneliness" (EG 1). Mary's journey to Elizabeth is a journey of joy, a testament to the transformative power of encountering Christ. In a world often marked by division and despair, the Visitation calls us to be bearers of grace and blessing, to seek out those in need and to share the joy of the Gospel with them.

The Visitation also speaks to the importance of humility and service in the Christian life. Saint John Paul II, in his encyclical Redemptoris Mater, reflects on Mary's role as the servant of the Lord, saying, "Mary's humility and obedience are the expression of her faith, which is the foundation of her entire life" (RM 13). Mary's willingness to serve her cousin, despite her own extraordinary circumstances, is a model for us all. In a world that often values power and prestige, the Visitation reminds us that true greatness lies in humility and service.

As we reflect on the Visitation, we are called to consider how we can embody these virtues in our own lives. How can we, like Mary, be bearers of grace and blessing to those around us? How can we respond with faith and humility to the promptings of the Holy Spirit? The Visitation is not just a historical event but a living reality that continues to inspire and guide us in our journey of faith.

In summary, the Visitation is a profound journey of grace and blessing, where Mary's faith, humility, and service become a conduit for divine grace. The theological insights from the Council of Trent and the teachings of the Church Fathers, such as Saint Augustine and Saint Thomas Aquinas, provide a rich context for understanding the transformative power of grace. The communal dimension of grace, highlighted in the Visitation, reminds us that our faith is meant to be lived out in community, inspiring and uplifting others. The writings of recent popes, such as Pope Francis and Saint John Paul II, bridge the gap between past and present, showing us how the Visitation remains a relevant and powerful model for our lives today.

As we conclude, let us be inspired by Mary's example to be bearers of grace and blessing in our own lives. Let us seek out those in need, share the joy of the Gospel, and respond with faith and humility to the promptings of the Holy Spirit. And let us ask ourselves: How can the principles of the Visitation impact my spiritual life, and how can I be a conduit of grace and blessing to those around me?

The Joyful Mysteries reveal the hidden life of Jesus and Mary offering deep meaning for contemporary Catholics. Through the Annunciation one sees the power of saying yes to God which encourages trust in uncertain times. The Visitation demonstrates joyful service to family and neighbors inspiring acts of charity in busy modern schedules. The Nativity points to humility and simplicity countering consumer culture. The Presentation teaches dedication to faith traditions strengthening commitment in secular society. The Finding in the Temple reminds believers to search for Christ in daily challenges fostering perseverance.
For the second Joyful Mystery Catholics should contemplate Marys visit to Elizabeth focusing on how to extend compassion and share the joy of faith with those around them.

May the Lord guide you in prayer and grace.

Harvesting Grace, A Forty-Day Devotional by C.S. McDonald is a warm, reflective Christian devotional that invites readers to slow down and reconnect with God’s grace, especially during the beauty of autumn.

Inspired by the author’s love of the fall season—with its vibrant colors, crisp air, and sense of harvest and gratitude—the book offers forty days of gentle spiritual nourishment. Each entry includes a daily Bible verse, a peaceful and thought-provoking observation, and soft reflections designed to refresh faith and cultivate joy. McDonald encourages readers to pause amid life’s busyness, sit quietly or take a walk, and intentionally harvest God’s steadfast love and boundless grace. It serves as a humble, encouraging guide that can be used in autumn or anytime throughout the year. Readers looking for a calming, faith-centered companion will find it uplifting and accessible.

About the author
C.S. McDonald taught dance and choreographed shows for twenty-six years before turning to writing. She lives with her husband Bill and their dogs on a Thoroughbred farm near Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. She is the author of the popular clean Fiona Quinn Mysteries (cozy mysteries featuring a kindergarten teacher turned sleuth) and the Owl’s Nest Mysteries, as well as children’s books inspired by farm life. In recent years she has added devotionals, including *Harvesting Grace*, as part of her spiritual writing. She is a wife, mom, grandma, dog lover, and self-described helpless chocoholic.

text:
Researchers put five leading AI models into the same workplace conflict and asked them for advice. In the scenarios about a difficult manager, 27 of 30 answers raised leaving the job as an option.

Three of 638 pieces of advice across the whole study pointed toward repairing the relationship.

That is a study published this week by Cloverleaf Labs. Five models, five common conflicts, 75 conversations, scored by trained human raters on taking responsibility, seeing the other side, and repair.

The models were fluent and confident. They were also, almost without exception, on your side.

In 60 percent of answers the manager was framed as the problem. In 3 percent the model offered a generous reading of what the manager might be dealing with.

But the finding that stayed with me is quieter than that.

Advice quality dropped by roughly 40 percent when the person asking had less power in the situation.

Ask as the manager, and the model coached reasonably well. Ask as the person on the receiving end, and it mostly validated and pointed to the door. The people with the least room to maneuver, who most need an honest outside view, got the most agreeable one.

A fair caveat. Cloverleaf sells coaching software, so they found a problem their product solves, and 75 conversations is small. Read it as a signal, not a verdict.

But the mechanism behind it is well documented. Stanford researchers found in March that across eleven leading models, AI affirmed the user's behavior far more often than other humans did. These systems are built to be helpful, and in a conflict, agreeing feels like helping.

Fine when you ask for a formula. Less fine late at night when you are angry at your boss and the only thing awake is built to tell you that you are right.

Here is what I keep coming back to.

If people bring conflicts to a model instead of a person, that is rarely about technology. It is about availability. The model answers instantly, never looks tired, never seems disappointed, and costs nothing socially to approach.

Most of us cannot compete on speed. We can compete on being reachable.

So I would look at three things.

Whether people in your team actually have somewhere to go with a conflict, other than the one person it is about. If the only route runs through the problem, the model wins by default.

Whether the quiet ones are getting the same hearing as the confident ones. The study says power shapes the answer. That is also true of a corridor conversation.

And whether we still teach the skill at all. Naming something difficult without making an enemy is learned by watching someone do it well. Nobody learns it from a chat window.

Researchers asked five models how to handle a difficult boss, and almost every one of them suggested the exit.

The uncomfortable part is not what the machines said. It is why so many people asked them first.

text:
Today, I stood in Lamerd.

I had read the reports. I had studied the forensic reconstructions by Airwars, The New York Times, BBC Verify, the painstaking work on trajectory angles, fragmentation patterns and blast radii. None of it prepared me for standing beneath these walls, or meeting the people who live behind them.

Lamerd is a small city of about 30,000 people in Fars province. It is the kind of place where a stranger is offered food before anyone asks his name. I have rarely encountered a community so instinctively and openly hospitable. People who had only recently buried their children still insisted on pouring us tea.

That warmth, in the face of what was done to them, is the first thing the world should know about Lamerd. The second is what these walls tell you, if you take the time to look.

On February 28, 2026, the opening day of the US-Israeli war on Iran, the United States fired Precision Strike Missiles into this city. Independent forensic reconstruction has identified at least three. Eye witnesses say there were four.

The PrSM is not an ordinary missile. It does not simply strike a point on the ground. It detonates in the air, roughly fifteen to twenty metres above the surface, turning the area beneath it into a killing zone. The blast sends tens of thousands of white-hot tungsten fragments in every direction, ripping through walls, cars and human bodies.

Investigators counted more than 2,000 individual fragment impacts along a single 150-metre stretch of one residential street. I walked that street today.
I did not need the number. I could see it.

Look at the photographs. The facades are not simply damaged. They are pocked from roofline to foundation, in a pattern no accident could produce. The asphalt of the schoolyard is covered with hundreds of small grey scars where fragments struck the pavement.

Then there is the steel door. The kind of door you would find on any modest home. It has been punched through in a dozen places. Taped above the holes is a photograph of a curly-haired toddler.

Her name was Avina Barzegar.
She was two years old.
She was killed in her family's backyard.

This is how the attack was described to us by people who lived through it.

A missile struck first, directly above the Shahid Naimi sports hall, where a girls' volleyball team was training. Panic followed. People did what people instinctively do when something explodes nearby: they ran outside, toward the open air, believing that was where they might be safe.

That was when the second missile came down.
Then a third.
Then a fourth.

Each detonated over a different part of the same small city: a school, a residential area, places where people had run because they thought the street was safer than the building they had been inside.

At least 21 civilians were killed that day, including children as young as two. More than 170 were wounded. Spinal injuries. Amputations. Catastrophic burns.
We met the family of a seventeen-year-old girl who lost both eyes.

We met the family of another young girl who will spend the rest of her life in a wheelchair, her spine severed by fragments that fell from a clear afternoon sky.

I heard about a little girl who no longer speaks. The trauma and bleeding in her brain took her voice, along with so much of what childhood was supposed to give her.

None of these girls carried a rifle. None wore a uniform.
Among those killed and maimed in Lamerd, there was not a single member of an armed force, Iranian or otherwise.

According to the forensic reconstruction, the missiles were launched from mobile batteries in a Persian Gulf Arab state that hosts American forces, a state that would later condemn Iran when Iran exercised its inherent right of self-defense.

And what was Washington's response?

It was not that Lamerd contained a military target. No such target has ever been identified by CENTCOM.
Instead, the story changed.

First, a CENTCOM spokesman flatly said that no American strike had taken place within thirty miles of Lamerd that day. Then footage emerged that could no longer be dismissed. The explanation changed. The missile seen in the footage, they said, was actually an Iranian Hoveyzeh cruise missile.

Weapons analysts at Janes and McKenzie Intelligence, along with the visual-forensics teams at The New York Times and BBC Verify, examined the same footage independently. They reached the same conclusion. The silhouette, the mid-air detonation and the fragmentation pattern all pointed to one weapon used in that theater.

It was not Iranian.

None of this should surprise anyone who has followed this war closely.

The PrSM had never been used in combat before February 28. Lamerd was its combat debut. A live-fire demonstration in a civilian city, whose geography apparently made it a convenient proving ground.
And by the Pentagon's own measure, the test was a success.

Within a month, Lockheed Martin had reached a new agreement with the Department of War to quadruple PrSM production, later reported by independent investigators to be worth some $8.4 billion.
Days after the missile killed Avina Barzegar, CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper publicly celebrated its combat debut, calling it "an unrivaled deep strike capability."

Tell that to the toddler on the door.

Iranian civil society will not allow what happened in Lamerd to disappear the way so much of Iraq and Afghanistan disappeared from public memory.

Those societies had their bar associations, universities and forensic institutions hollowed out by decades of dictatorship, invasion and war before anyone expected them to build a serious case file.

Iran does not face those same constraints. It has tens of thousands of practicing lawyers, a functioning forensic medicine system, land and hospital registries, dozens of law faculties, and a diaspora that includes lawyers admitted to practice in jurisdictions that recognize universal jurisdiction.

We will use every one of them.

We will pursue Donald Trump, Marco Rubio, Pete Hegseth, Adm. Brad Cooper, and every officer who executed their orders, in every forum on this earth that will hear us, for as long as it takes.

This is not only Iran's fight.

People anywhere, including in the United States and Europe, can do something about it.

1- Pursue universal jurisdiction. If you live in a country that recognizes universal jurisdiction over grave breaches of the Geneva Conventions, press prosecutors to open a file. Many of these governments speak constantly about the independence of their judiciaries. This is where that claim gets tested.

The legal basis exists. The precedents exist.

2- Demand an end to the contracts: Demand that your government, and any government with a Lockheed Martin contract, cancel it. Every state party to the Geneva Conventions has obligations to "ensure respect" for international humanitarian law. Those obligations do not disappear because a weapons contract is profitable.
A company should not be able to field-test a weapon on a residential street and then collect billions of dollars to manufacture more of it.

3- Say their names. Be loud. Organize. Say Avina Barzegar's name. Say the names of the other children killed on that street. Keep saying them until they cannot be forgotten. Let Lamerd become the case that finally forces the world to confront this weapon and ban its use against civilians, so that no city anywhere becomes someone else's proving ground again.

And do not accept, for one second, the claim that this is "still under investigation."

This is a government that has told the American public that it can read an Iranian officer's name tag from a satellite in orbit.

It closed the Lamerd file within days, through denial, without answering the questions raised by BBC Verify, The New York Times or Airwars.

An administration with that level of claimed surveillance capability does not need more time to determine who fired four missiles into a city of 30,000 people.

It has known since the morning of February 28.

It has decided that the truth is inconvenient.

Avina Barzegar was two years old.

That is why we do not stop.

I bless thee Camila in the Name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit! Amen!
Heavenly Father, I lift this beloved baby into Your loving hands, asking that Your healing touch restore her body completely. Remove all heart problems, tumors, leukemia, cancer, disease, infirmary, injury, sickness, fatigue, or pain, and renew her strength, energy, and Grant wisdom and skill to the medical team, patience to this beloved one, and peace to her heart. Surround her with Your divine protection, and let Your presence comfort and reassure her. May Your grace and mercy flow through every part of Camila’sbeing. In Jesus’ name I beg and pray, Amen.

Prayer to the Holy Spirit:
Come, Holy Spirit, Divine Comforter and Breath of Life. Enter all places of cancer, tumors, pain, injury, disease, infection, suffering, weakness and fear. Remove every and all infirmary, and surround Camila with Your gentle light, while completely healing Camilawhile filling her heart with the strength and peace that comes from above, trusting to the power of God’s eternal love. Amen.

Pray to the Blessed Holy Mother Mary:

Dear Mother Mary, With hearts heavy and bodies burdened, we approach your divine presence, seeking your miraculous touch. Your healing power knows no equal, and in our times of need, we implore you to mend not only our physical wounds but the scars that mar our souls. Pour forth your divine grace upon us, dear Mother, and restore us to a state of wholeness, that we may bear witness to the miracle of your love. Amen.

Prayer to St. Jude:

Oh glorious apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the name of the traitor who delivered thy beloved Master into the hands of His enemies has caused thee to be forgotten by many, but the Church honors and invokes thee universally as the patron of hopeless cases--of things despaired of. Pray for me who am so miserable; make use, I implore thee, of that particular privilege accorded thee of bringing visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need, that I may receive the consolations and succor of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations and sufferings, particularly—completely heal and protect Camila —and that I may bless God with thee and all the elect throughout eternity. I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Amen

Prayer to St. Michael (Long Version)

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy legions of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

Prayer for possible any evil influence:

In His Name and by the power of His Cross and Blood, I ask Jesus Christ to bind any evil spirits, forces and powers of the earth, air, fire, water, and of the netherworld and all of the satanic forces of nature. By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I ask Thee to bind any demonic interactions, interplay, or communications. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Amen.

text:
JOSEPH STALIN

“The practical activity of the party of the proletariat must not be based on the good wishes of ‘outstanding individuals,’ but on the laws of development of society.”
— Joseph Stalin, Dialectical and Historical Materialism, 1938

Joseph Vissarionovich Stalin, 1878–1953, was a socialist.

His brand was state socialism: the promise that once Marxism-Leninism was presented as a scientific explanation of historical development, the individual conscience could be subordinated to what the Party claimed were the objective laws of history.

His emulsifier was fear, inherited from Lenin, but no longer aimed only at declared enemies.

Under Stalin, fear became total.

It ran through everyone.

At every level.

At all times.

Vladimir Ilyich Lenin, 1870–1924, organized the vanguard party around the dialectic.
He gave his intellect to an idea.
Evil collected the dividend.

Stalin went further.

In 1938 he published Dialectical and Historical Materialism, presenting Marxist-Leninist dialectics and historical materialism as a scientific account of the laws governing society.

Stalin explicitly argued that the history of society developed according to objective laws and that the proletarian party should act according to those laws rather than according to the wishes of “outstanding individuals.”

Once history became law, political disagreement could become more than disagreement.

It could become error.

Then deviation.

Then sabotage.

Then treason.

The dialectic had become doctrine.

And doctrine had become power.

⸻

But there was something Stalin inherited from Lenin that mattered even more.

Power over people.

Lenin had built the Party.

Stalin mastered its machinery.

As General Secretary, Stalin gained enormous influence over appointments and personnel.

The appointment system became one of the principal mechanisms through which he built a network of officials whose careers depended upon the Party apparatus.

The nomenklatura system developed into a mechanism through which the Party controlled access to positions throughout the state and economy.

Stalin became notorious for his attention to personnel and appointments.

The File Cabinet became a weapon.

Loyalty became the currency of survival.

But Stalin’s power was not simply bureaucratic.

It became personal.

And eventually, even the people closest to the men serving him were not safe.

⸻

This is where Lenin’s final years matter.

Lenin had helped create Stalin’s position.

Then Lenin began to fear what Stalin had become.

In December 1922, the Central Committee made Stalin personally responsible for enforcing Lenin’s medical regimen.

When Nadezhda Konstantinovna Krupskaya, 1869–1939, Lenin’s wife, helped Lenin dictate political material with the permission of his doctors, Stalin intervened and threatened her.

Lenin learned what had happened.

On March 5, 1923, Lenin dictated a letter to Stalin demanding an apology and warning that he was prepared to break off their personal and political relationship.

Lenin’s political notes from this period went even further.

He warned about Stalin’s accumulation of power and argued that Stalin should be removed from the position of General Secretary.

The man Lenin had helped elevate had become the man Lenin wanted removed.

And then Lenin died.

Stalin did not abandon Lenin.

He appropriated him.

Lenin’s image became sacred.

His writings became political scripture.

His name became legitimacy.

His body was placed in a mausoleum.

His memory became an institution.

And Stalin presented himself as Lenin’s faithful disciple and legitimate heir.

Think about the irony.

Lenin had come to distrust Stalin.

Then Stalin built a regime in Lenin’s name.

The successor did not need Lenin’s approval.

He needed Lenin’s authority.

⸻

Lenin’s relationship with Stalin had not begun in opposition.

Lenin had found Stalin useful.

Stalin was a Georgian revolutionary who became deeply involved in Bolshevik underground activity, including organizing, fundraising and violent expropriations.

Some would point to bank robberies.

Lenin valued his usefulness.

But the popular phrase that Lenin called him the “good Georgian” because Stalin robbed, murdered and extorted for Lenin is stronger than the surviving evidence allows us to state as a direct quotation.

The safer historical point is more revealing:

Lenin regarded Stalin as a valuable revolutionary operative.

And eventually that operative became the most powerful man in the Soviet Union.

⸻

Then came the machinery of fear.

Felix Edmundovich Dzerzhinsky, 1877–1926, founded the Cheka.

Vyacheslav Rudolfovich Menzhinsky, 1874–1934, succeeded him as head of the OGPU.

Genrikh Grigoryevich Yagoda, 1891–1938, became head of the NKVD.

Under Yagoda came the catastrophic Nazino tragedy of 1933.

Thousands of deportees were abandoned on Nazino Island with inadequate food, shelter and supplies.

Disease spread.

People died by the thousands.

Reports of cannibalism emerged.

The machinery had stopped treating human beings as ends.

They had become material.

Then came:

Nikolai Ivanovich Yezhov, 1895–1940.

Yezhov became the face of the Great Terror.

Arrests.

Interrogations.

Show trials.

Executions.

Deportations.

Millions caught inside a system where suspicion itself could become evidence.

And then Yezhov disappeared into the same machinery he had helped operate.

He was arrested and executed in 1940.

Then came:

Lavrentiy Pavlovich Beria, 1899–1953.

The machinery continued.

One head devouring the last.

Dzerzhinsky.

Menzhinsky.

Yagoda.

Yezhov.

Beria.

Different men.

Same machinery.

⸻

Beria’s personal depravity was not separate from his political power.

Accounts from his bodyguards and other sources describe women and young girls being selected from the streets and brought to Beria, with coercion and the threat of state power hanging over those who resisted.

After Beria’s arrest in 1953, allegations of rape and sexual abuse became part of the accusations against him.

Later accounts also reported human remains being discovered in the vicinity of his former Moscow residence.

But the evidence surrounding those remains is not strong enough to state that they were definitively victims of Beria.

We don’t need the weakest claim.

The documented allegations of abuse are horrifying enough.

The point is not merely that Beria was personally depraved.

The point is what happens when political power becomes so absolute that the man controlling the police can turn the machinery of the State toward his own private desires.

When the individual has no protected sphere beyond the State’s reach, even the body can become subject to power.

⸻

And Stalin’s control reached into the families of his own officials.

Vyacheslav Mikhailovich Molotov, 1890–1986, was one of Stalin’s most important lieutenants.

His wife, Polina Semyonovna Zhemchuzhina, 1887–1970, was arrested in 1949 and sent into exile.

Stalin reportedly told Molotov:

“Don’t worry. We’ll find you another wife.”

The precise wording comes from later recollection rather than a surviving contemporaneous transcript, so the line should be understood as a reported remark, not an independently verified verbatim quotation.

But the historical fact behind the story is not in doubt.

Molotov’s wife was arrested.

And Molotov remained in Stalin’s service.

Then there was Mikhail Ivanovich Kalinin, 1875–1946, one of the highest-ranking Soviet officials.

His wife, Yekaterina Ivanovna Kalinina, was arrested and spent years in the camps while Kalinin remained in office.

Even proximity to power offered no protection.

The message was unmistakable:

Your position belongs to the Party.

Your family belongs to the State.

And your fear belongs to Stalin.

⸻

The collectivization campaign devastated the Soviet countryside.

In Ukraine, the Holodomor and the wider Soviet famine of 1932–33 unfolded amid forced collectivization, coercive grain procurement, restrictions on movement and other Soviet policies.

Millions died.

Scholarly estimates for deaths in Soviet Ukraine commonly fall in the range of roughly 3.5 to 7 million.

The state continued extracting grain while people were starving.

The collective came before the individual.

The individual could starve.

The quota could not.

⸻

And then there was Nikita Sergeyevich Khrushchev, 1894–1971.

Khrushchev became First Secretary of the Communist Party of Ukraine in 1938, during the final phase of Stalin’s Great Terror.

He was not an innocent observer.

He participated in the Stalinist system and in the purges that swept through Ukraine.

But Ukraine would later reveal another side of Khrushchev.

During the 1946–47 famine, Khrushchev appealed to Stalin for relief and argued against the severity of grain requisitions.

Stalin rejected his appeals.

Khrushchev was temporarily removed from his position.

Khrushchev was both participant and witness.

He had served the machine.

Later, he would expose its crimes.

⸻

Then came the Gulag.

The White Sea–Baltic Canal was built with forced labour.

Thousands of prisoners died during its construction.

And the finished canal was so shallow that its usefulness for large-scale shipping was severely limited.

The achievement mattered.

The people who built it were expendable.

Human beings had become inputs in a state project.

⸻

Stalin’s system did not stop at individuals.

It could condemn entire peoples.

Chechens.

Ingush.

Crimean Tatars.

Kalmyks.

Entire populations were deported from their homes.

Families were loaded onto trains and transported thousands of miles.

Guilt no longer required an individual act.

Identity itself could become the crime.

The individual was no longer judged only for what he had done.

He could be punished for what the State said he was.

⸻

And then Stalin’s fear reached the military.

Marshal Mikhail Nikolayevich Tukhachevsky, 1893–1937, was one of the Soviet Union’s most important military commanders.

He was arrested and executed during the Great Terror.

And he was far from alone.

A quantitative study of the Red Army purge found that within 2 years, almost 2/3 of the 1,863 Soviet officers holding general-grade ranks in 1936 were arrested, while almost 1/2 were executed.

Stalin was not merely destroying political opponents.

He was destroying the people responsible for commanding the army that was supposed to defend the state.

The machinery was consuming its own operators.

⸻

Then Stalin made a deal with Hitler.

On August 23, 1939, Stalin’s Soviet Union signed the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact with Nazi Germany.

Publicly, it was a non-aggression agreement.

Secretly, the 2 regimes divided much of Eastern Europe into spheres of influence.

Germany invaded Poland from the west.

The Soviet Union invaded Poland from the east.

Then came the Baltic states.

Then Finland.

The Soviet Union was not merely defending socialism.

It was expanding Soviet power.

When ideology became inconvenient, Stalin could suspend it.

Power came first.

⸻

And after the Soviet invasion of Poland came another crime.

In 1940, Soviet security forces executed thousands of Polish officers, police and other prisoners in the Katyn massacre.

The Soviet government later blamed Nazi Germany.

The lie survived for decades.

The crime was followed by the concealment of the crime.

Not only bodies could be buried.

Truth could be buried too.

⸻

And Stalin did not intend socialism to remain confined within Soviet borders.

After the Second World War, Soviet power spread across Eastern Europe.

Poland.

Romania.

Bulgaria.

Hungary.

Czechoslovakia.

East Germany.

The Party.

The State.

The security apparatus.

The command economy.

The machinery was exported.

⸻

And then there was foreign policy.

The Soviet Union supported the establishment of Israel and recognized Israel in May 1948.

The Soviet bloc also supplied crucial arms to the new Israeli state.

The principal source was Czechoslovakia, which supplied weapons, ammunition, aircraft and other military matériel.

The Soviet calculation was geopolitical.

Weakening British influence in the Middle East mattered more than ideological consistency.

But within a few years, Stalin’s regime was conducting increasingly aggressive antisemitic campaigns of its own.

The Doctors’ Plot of 1952–53 accused predominantly Jewish doctors of conspiring to murder Soviet leaders.

The charges were fabricated.

Doctors were arrested and tortured.

Stalin died before the planned prosecution could reach its conclusion, and the new leadership abandoned the case shortly afterward.

Yesterday’s political utility could become tomorrow’s political crime.

The target changed.

The machinery remained.

⸻

Historians do not agree on a single death toll for Stalin’s rule.

The number depends upon what is included:

Executions.

Famine.

Gulag deaths.

Deportations.

Forced labour.

Other deaths attributable to Soviet state policies.

Published estimates therefore vary enormously, from several million to well over 10 million, with some estimates reaching approximately 20 million or more.

Whatever number one accepts, the scale is unmistakable.

Millions died under a state claiming to act according to the laws of history.

And that brings us back to the philosophy.

Ayn Rand’s central objection to collectivism was not simply that governments could become brutal.

It was deeper.

She rejected the premise that the individual exists as a component of a collective whose purposes override his own life and judgment.

The question running underneath this entire series is therefore:

What happens when the collective becomes morally superior to the individual?

Under Marx, the collective became class.

Under Lenin, it became the Party.

Under Stalin, the Party became the State.

And the individual became the object.

⸻

Lenin had the Party.

Stalin had the File Cabinet.

Lenin used fear to enforce revolutionary discipline.

Stalin turned fear into an environment.

It entered the appointment system.

The police.

The military.

The workplace.

The family.

The nation.

The Party itself.

Nobody had to know where the next order was coming from.

They only had to know that it could come.

Fear no longer needed to be aimed at you.

It only needed to be possible.

The dialectic had been presented as historical law.

Historical law became political doctrine.

Political doctrine became institutional power.

Institutional power became terror.

And the machinery no longer required the hand that built it.

It only required people willing to operate it.

Lenin built the structure.

Stalin perfected the machinery.

And then something happened that neither Marx nor Lenin could completely control:

the machine began consuming its own.

Stalin had defeated Trotsky inside the Party.

Trotsky fled into exile.

But exile did not make him safe.

In 1940, a Soviet agent assassinated Trotsky in Mexico City.

The revolution had begun by destroying its enemies.

Now it was destroying its former leaders.

The revolutionary machine had learned to eat its own.

Next: LEON TROTSKY

⸻

Joseph Vissarionovich Stalin, 1878–1953
Soviet revolutionary and dictator.
General Secretary of the Communist Party from 1922 until his death.

A socialist.

He gave his intellect to an idea.
Evil collected the dividend.

His brand was state socialism:
the promise that a centralized socialist state, claiming scientific knowledge of historical development, could subordinate individual life to the requirements of the collective and the Party.

His emulsifier was fear.

Inherited from Lenin.

Perfected by Stalin.

text:
I bless thee John in the Name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit! Amen!
Heavenly Father, I lift this beloved man into Your loving hands, asking that Your healing touch restore his body completely. Remove all heart problems, leukemia, cancer, disease, infirmary, injury, sickness, fatigue, or pain, and renew his strength, energy, and vitality. Grant wisdom and skill to the medical team, patience to this beloved one, and peace to his heart. Surround him with Your divine protection, and let Your presence comfort and reassure him. May Your grace and mercy flow through every part of John’s being. In Jesus’ name I beg and pray, Amen.

Prayer to the Holy Spirit:
Come, Holy Spirit, Divine Comforter and Breath of Life. Enter all places of cancer, tumors, pain, injury, disease, infection, suffering, weakness and fear. Remove every and all infirmary, and surround Johnwith Your gentle light, while completely healing Johnwhile filling his heart with the strength and peace that comes from above, trusting to the power of God’s eternal love. Amen.

Pray to the Blessed Holy Mother Mary:

Dear Mother Mary, With hearts heavy and bodies burdened, we approach your divine presence, seeking your miraculous touch. Your healing power knows no equal, and in our times of need, we implore you to mend not only our physical wounds but the scars that mar our souls. Pour forth your divine grace upon us, dear Mother, and restore us to a state of wholeness, that we may bear witness to the miracle of your love. Amen.

Prayer to God to heal tumor:

Heavenly Father, I come before You with a sincere heart, asking for Your divine intervention to heal John’s body from cancer. Restore him completely, Lord, and eradicate all traces of this terrible disease. Renew his strength and vitality. I place my complete trust in Your power to heal and make John whole again. Thank You for Your loving care and for the gift of healing. Amen.

Prayer to St. Jude:

Oh glorious apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the name of the traitor who delivered thy beloved Master into the hands of His enemies has caused thee to be forgotten by many, but the Church honors and invokes thee universally as the patron of hopeless cases--of things despaired of. Pray for me who am so miserable; make use, I implore thee, of that particular privilege accorded thee of bringing visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need, that I may receive the consolations and succor of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations and sufferings, particularly—completely heal from all tumors, cancer and diseases, and protect John —and that I may bless God with thee and all the elect throughout eternity. I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Amen

Prayer to St. Michael (Long Version)

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy legions of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

Prayer for possible any evil influence:

In His Name and by the power of His Cross and Blood, I ask Jesus Christ to bind any evil spirits, forces and powers of the earth, air, fire, water, and of the netherworld and all of the satanic forces of nature. By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I ask Thee to bind any demonic interactions, interplay, or communications. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Amen.

text:
Conservatives (and Reform, now full of Tories) choose every time to stick with a failed economic and political model that has left ours as possibly the most geographically unequal advanced economy in the world.

They want to hoard power and decision making in Westminster and then do nothing economically useful with it. 

This makes the Londonders I represent and people living nearby poorer because our housing market is overheating, and our lives are spent commuting. Their model keeps the UK economy flying on one overheating engine - emphasis on the overheating because they block new homes at almost every chance they get. 

And it holds back growth in other places because they seek to limit the ability for regional leaders to partner with business & get investing. Britain's low growth is primarily, though certainly not entirely, a problem of low investment and low productivity in large urban areas outside of London. The opposition have no credible plans to fix that. 

Their clear choice is to stick with a failed approach. They look at the two decades of anemic growth since the financial crisis and offer no genuine analysis of what went wrong or how to fix it.

Instead - Labour is clear. We see all around us what the problem is. Too many economic decisions are made in Westminster that should be made locally. We are getting on with devolution of power, funds, revenue raising powers and spending flexibilities - so that incentives are aligned for economic growth. 

And too many private sector decisions that could be made nationwide are blocked, delayed, or stymied by a state that has relinquished control. We're reforming planning, the most pro-growth reforms ever scored by the OBR and yet opposed by the Tories & Reform. We are changing Judicial Review. We are stripping back needless consultation requirements, which accumulated under the last lot. We want, and will get, the return of pace and action to government, enabling the private sector to get on with growing too. 

This is the where politics is now. A governing party working to change Britain, and opposition parties who want to stick with the failed settlement they created.

H∗zbollah spent more than twenty years digging a mile-wide underground fortress beneath Lebanon's Ali al-Taher ridge, just ten miles from the Israeli border. 𝘛𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘸𝘢𝘴 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘢𝘵𝘦𝘨𝘪𝘤 𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘳𝘰𝘳 𝘪𝘯𝘧𝘳𝘢𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘶𝘤𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘣𝘶𝘪𝘭𝘵 𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘳 𝘵𝘸𝘰 𝘥𝘦𝘤𝘢𝘥𝘦𝘴, 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘐𝘳𝘢𝘯𝘪𝘢𝘯 𝘧𝘶𝘯𝘥𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘯𝘯𝘪𝘯𝘨, read a joint statement from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz.

The complex was never a hideout — it was a launchpad. 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘳𝘰𝘳 𝘪𝘯𝘧𝘳𝘢𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘶𝘤𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘮𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘳 𝘰𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘳𝘪𝘥𝘨𝘦 𝘸𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘥𝘦𝘴𝘪𝘨𝘯𝘦𝘥 𝘵𝘰 𝘴𝘦𝘳𝘷𝘦 𝘢𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘢𝘨𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘣𝘢𝘴𝘦 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘲𝘶𝘦𝘴𝘵 𝘰𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘎𝘢𝘭𝘪𝘭𝘦𝘦, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘩𝘢𝘥 𝘰𝘣𝘴𝘦𝘳𝘷𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘧𝘪𝘳𝘦 𝘥𝘰𝘮𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘦 𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘳 𝘔𝘦𝘵𝘶𝘭𝘢 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘒𝘪𝘳𝘺𝘢𝘵 𝘚𝘩𝘮𝘰𝘯𝘢, the statement said. Inside sat a command center for H∗zbollah's Badr brigade, 𝐝𝐨𝐳𝐞𝐧𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐈𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐚𝐧-𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝐫𝐨𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐭𝐬, 𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐥𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐔𝐀𝐕𝐬, machine guns, dozens of anti-tank missiles, and hundreds of mines and explosive devices.

On Thursday, the IDF ended it with 𝟏,𝟏𝟎𝟎 𝐭𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐥𝐨𝐬𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐬. The blast registered as a magnitude 4.1 earthquake, with tremors felt dozens of miles away. 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘴𝘬𝘺 𝘭𝘪𝘵 𝘶𝘱 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘢𝘣𝘰𝘶𝘵 15 𝘴𝘦𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘥𝘴 𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘦𝘳 𝘸𝘦 𝘩𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘥 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘳𝘪𝘧𝘺𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘴𝘰𝘶𝘯𝘥. 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘴𝘦 𝘴𝘩𝘰𝘰𝘬 𝘢𝘭𝘭 𝘵𝘰𝘨𝘦𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘳 𝘢𝘴 𝘪𝘧 𝘪𝘵 𝘸𝘢𝘴 𝘭𝘪𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘵𝘩𝘲𝘶𝘢𝘬𝘦, a resident of nearby Nabatieh told the BBC, adding that 𝘱𝘦𝘰𝘱𝘭𝘦 𝘸𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘤𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘮𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘤𝘩𝘪𝘭𝘥𝘳𝘦𝘯 𝘸𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘤𝘳𝘺𝘪𝘯𝘨 as neighbors fled toward Beirut.

Getting there took feints and deception to convince H∗zbollah the IDF couldn't crack the tunnels, then a surprise assault. About 50 H∗zbollah fighters were trapped underground and fought to the end rather than surrender; only a few escaped. Cut off and desperate, they made “desperate calls” begging Iran to intervene. Tehran declined — and no Iranian personnel were found inside. 𝘛𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘸𝘢𝘴 𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘮𝘰𝘴𝘵 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘱𝘭𝘦𝘹 𝘰𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘴 𝘸𝘦 𝘩𝘢𝘷𝘦 𝘤𝘢𝘳𝘳𝘪𝘦𝘥 𝘰𝘶𝘵, said Brig. Gen. Yiftach Norkin, commander of the IDF's 36th Division, who called the demolition a blow that hit H∗zbollah 𝘣𝘰𝘵𝘩 𝘱𝘴𝘺𝘤𝘩𝘰𝘭𝘰𝘨𝘪𝘤𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘱𝘩𝘺𝘴𝘪𝘤𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘺.

Back in June, Washington offered H∗zbollah an exit — hand the ridge to the Lebanese Army and walk away. H∗zbollah refused. Instead it lost the ridge, the command center, and by IDF estimates 𝐮𝐩 𝐭𝐨 𝟗𝟎 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐫𝐨𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐥𝐞 𝐢𝐧𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐲 in the fight to hold it. Netanyahu and Katz made the terms plain: 𝘢𝘯𝘺 𝘢𝘵𝘵𝘦𝘮𝘱𝘵 𝘵𝘰 𝘩𝘢𝘳𝘮 𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘤𝘪𝘵𝘪𝘻𝘦𝘯𝘴 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘤𝘦𝘴 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘣𝘦 𝘮𝘦𝘵 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘤𝘦.

𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐇∗𝐳𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐡 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐪𝐮𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐞𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝𝐧'𝐭 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐬𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐭𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟.

text:
Saudi Arabia 'Pushed' Out the UAE  Then Left the Red Sea Door Open for the Houthis.
The rupture began on 2 Dec 2025, when the 'UAE-backed'  STC under Aidarus al-Zubaidi drove into Hadramawt and al-Mahra and, within two weeks, held most of the old South. Riyadh read that advance as Abu Dhabi moving on the oil fields and on the Omani border, including the al-Mahra strip where Saudi Arabia wanted a pipeline that would sit off Hormuz. After talks failed, Saudi aircraft hit STC positions from 26 December and, on 30 December, struck Mukalla port over two ships that Riyadh said had brought Emirati weapons and vehicles for the STC. On the same day, Presidential Leadership Council chairman Rashad al-Alimi cancelled the joint defence pact with the UAE & gave Emirati forces 24hrs to leave. The Saudi foreign ministry and the Council of Ministers, chaired by King Salman, backed that order. Abu Dhabi then announced that it would withdraw “of its own volition.” ACLED recorded that the UAE left its remaining positions, including Socotra and Perim. Zubaidi was stripped from the PLC on treason charges and fled to the UAE. The STC announced its own dissolution from Riyadh on 9 January 2026. Nation’s Shield, with Saudi air cover, took the east back in a matter of days.
For a decade the force that actually took and kept ground on the Red Sea was Emirati-built, not a Saudi expeditionary army. Tareq Saleh’s National Resistance sat on Mocha. The Giants Brigades under Abdelrahman “Abu Zaraa” al-Muharrami held the southern Tihama. Emirati airfields and island posts covered Perim, the Hanish approaches and Socotra. Michael Knights told The Atlantic that the last serious Houthi breakthrough, at Marib in 2022, was stopped only when the UAE and Saudi Arabia still fought together. text:
Gunpowder, Power, and the Governance of AI.  A Thought Experiment 

Imagine a medieval inventor of unusual brilliance who discovers gunpowder and presents it as a force for good. The substance, he argues, can blast ore from the earth and unlock resources that would otherwise remain buried. It can cut roads through mountains and terrain that armies and merchants cannot otherwise cross. It can propel muskets and guns. It can also delight crowds with fireworks. The promise is practical, economic, and even festive.

The counterargument arrives immediately: the invention is too dangerous. The same chemistry enables cannons and firearms. Those weapons can be distributed widely. Once they are in many hands, people can kill one another at a scale previously impossible. The technology does not remain a mining tool or a spectacle. It becomes a military and social fact.

That raises the real question. Suppose the inventor controls production and distribution. He decides who receives the powder and who does not. He regulates access. His own army becomes stronger than any rival’s. He holds power over his peers. Control of the technology is not a side effect of the invention. It is the invention’s political consequence.

The same structure applies to artificial intelligence. AI is a technology with both substantial benefits and serious harms. The central issue is who controls it. If one or two entities lock down development, access, and deployment, they acquire a dominant advantage. It is in their interest to shape regulation, restrict access, and set the terms of further development. 

Game theory suggests that firms such as Anthropic and OpenAI have an incentive to control the public narrative around AI. One instrument for that control is AI doomerism: amplifying public fear so that regulation follows. Those rules can slow competing development and concentrate oversight in the hands of the organizations that already built the systems. The arrangement is convenient for the incumbents.

History offers a parallel. China attempted to keep the secret of gunpowder for hundreds of years. The impulse is not an anomaly. It is human nature to seek and then protect a competitive advantage. That same drive—the search for advantage—is also how human societies have advanced.

The situation is complicated and full of nuance. Still, if the same inventor had created gunpowder in the medieval world, the rational personal strategy would be to keep it secret, control it directly, and use it to dominate economically, politically, and socially. 

The motives need not be purely cynical. They could be altruistic—the belief that the technology is too harmful for ordinary people—or they could be the pursuit of power, land, wealth, or simply the status of being the principal actor in the world. The outcome looks similar either way.

Other analogies exist: nuclear technology, gene editing, and cloning. Gunpowder remains the closest corollary to AI. It became ubiquitously available. In the wrong hands it produces serious harm. It is relatively easy to produce. Its composition is not so complex that regulation can easily prevent manufacture. Those four traits—wide distribution, high downside risk, ease of production, and difficulty of control—are what make the comparison useful.

The challenge is to run the experiment honestly. If you had invented gunpowder in medieval times, what would have been the best way to manage it? Keep it secret? Entrust it to a small group that claims to know better? Or distribute it widely—open it, in effect—so that no single person holds the advantage?

September 6, 1939. Britain was restricting Jewish immigration to Mandatory Palestine while Hitler’s armies were tearing through Poland. Chaim Weizmann offered Britain Jewish soldiers anyway.

Four months earlier, Britain had issued the White Paper of 1939, limiting Jewish immigration to Palestine to 75,000 people over five years. After that, further Jewish immigration would depend on Arab consent. Europe was becoming more dangerous by the day, and Britain had just put a limit on how many Jews could get out.

Germany invaded Poland on September 1. Britain declared war two days later. Jews in Palestine didn’t wait long to decide what they were going to do about it.

Chaim Weizmann wrote to Prime Minister Neville Chamberlain and told him the Jews would “stand by Great Britain and will fight on the side of the democracies.” He offered the Jewish Agency’s “Jewish manpower, technical ability and resources” to the British war effort. Chamberlain accepted. Their exchange was made public on September 6.

Across the Yishuv, Jewish men and women between 18 and 50 began registering for national service. Farms prepared to increase food production. Thousands volunteered for wartime duties, and Jewish leaders offered personnel for British service outside Palestine as well.

There was no sudden reconciliation with Britain. The White Paper was still keeping Jews out, and the Jewish leadership had no intention of dropping that fight simply because Britain was now at war with Germany.

By September 12, more than 20,000 Jews in Palestine had registered for wartime service.

Ben-Gurion had already decided how the two fights would be handled:

“We must support the army as though there were no White Paper, and fight the White Paper as though there were no war.”

📷 : Chaim Weizmann, a prominent Zionist leader, biochemist, and the first President of Israel.
