Ritual and Moral Holiness
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
“Speak to all the congregation of the Israelites and say to them: You shall be holy, for I the LORD your God am holy. You shall each revere your mother and father, and you shall keep my Sabbaths: I am the LORD your God. Do not turn to idols or make cast images for yourselves: I am the LORD your God.
“When you offer a sacrifice of well-being to the LORD, offer it in such a way that it is acceptable on your behalf. It shall be eaten on the same day you offer it or on the next day, and anything left over until the third day shall be consumed in fire. If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is an abomination; it will not be acceptable. All who eat it shall be subject to punishment, because they have profaned what is holy to the LORD, and any such person shall be cut off from the people.
“When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. You shall not strip your vineyard bare or gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and the alien: I am the LORD your God.
“You shall not steal; you shall not deal falsely; and you shall not lie to one another. And you shall not swear falsely by my name, profaning the name of your God: I am the LORD.
“You shall not defraud your neighbor; you shall not steal; and you shall not keep for yourself the wages of a laborer until morning. You shall not revile the deaf or put a stumbling block before the blind; you shall fear your God: I am the LORD.
“You shall not render an unjust judgment; you shall not be partial to the poor or defer to the great: with justice you shall judge your neighbor. You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people, and you shall not stand idly by when the blood of your neighbor is at stake: I am the LORD.
“You shall not hate in your heart anyone of your kin; you shall reprove your neighbor, or you will incur guilt yourself. You shall not take vengeance or bear a grudge against any of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the LORD.
“You shall keep my statutes. You shall not let your animals breed with a different kind; you shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; nor shall you put on a garment made of two different materials.
“If a man has sexual relations with a woman who is a slave, designated for another man but not ransomed or given her freedom, an inquiry shall be held. They shall not be put to death, since she has not been freed, but he shall bring a guilt offering for himself to the LORD, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, a ram as guilt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of guilt offering before the LORD for his sin that he committed, and the sin he committed shall be forgiven him.
“When you come into the land and plant all kinds of trees for food, then you shall regard their fruit as forbidden; three years it shall be forbidden to you; it must not be eaten. In the fourth year all their fruit shall be set apart for rejoicing in the LORD. But in the fifth year you may eat of their fruit, that their yield may be increased for you: I am the LORD your God.
“You shall not eat anything with its blood. You shall not practice augury or witchcraft. You shall not round off the hair on your temples or mar the edges of your beard. You shall not make any gashes in your flesh for the dead or tattoo any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
“Do not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, that the land not become prostituted and full of depravity. You shall keep my Sabbaths and revere my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
“Do not turn to mediums and spiritualists; do not seek them out, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
“You shall rise before the aged and defer to the old, and you shall fear your God: I am the LORD.
“When an alien resides with you in your land, you shall not oppress the alien. The alien who resides with you shall be to you as the native-born among you; you shall love the alien as yourself, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
“You shall not cheat in measuring length, weight, or quantity. You shall have honest balances, honest weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt. You shall keep all my statutes and all my ordinances and observe them: I am the LORD.”
Penalties for Violations of Holiness
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying, “Say further to the Israelites:
“Any of the Israelites or of the aliens who reside in Israel who give any of their offspring to Molech shall be put to death; the people of the land shall stone them to death. I myself will set my face against them and will cut them off from the people, because they have given of their offspring to Molech, defiling my sanctuary and profaning my holy name. And if the people of the land should ever close their eyes to them, when they give of their offspring to Molech, and do not put them to death, I myself will set my face against them and against their family and will cut them off from among their people, them and all who follow them in prostituting themselves to Molech.
“If any turn to mediums or spiritualists, prostituting themselves to them, I will set my face against them and will cut them off from the people. Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, for I am the LORD your God. Keep my statutes and observe them: I am the LORD; I sanctify you. All who curse father or mother shall be put to death; having cursed father or mother, their bloodguilt is upon them.
“If a man commits adultery with the wife of his neighbor, both the adulterer and the adulteress shall be put to death. The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness; both of them shall be put to death; their bloodguilt is upon them. If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall be put to death; they have committed perversion; their bloodguilt is upon them. If a man lies with a male as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination; they shall be put to death; their bloodguilt is upon them. If a man takes a wife and her mother also, it is depravity; they shall be burned to death, both he and they, that there may be no depravity among you. If a man has sexual relations with an animal, he shall be put to death, and you shall kill the animal. If a woman approaches any animal and has sexual relations with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal; they shall be put to death; their bloodguilt is upon them.
“If a man takes his sister, a daughter of his father or a daughter of his mother, and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a disgrace, and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people; he has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall be subject to punishment. If a man lies with a woman during her period and uncovers her nakedness, he has laid bare her flow, and she has laid bare her flow of blood; both of them shall be cut off from their people. You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister or of your father’s sister, for that is to lay bare one’s own flesh; they shall be subject to punishment. If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness; they shall be subject to punishment; they shall die childless. If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is impurity; he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.
“You shall keep all my statutes and all my ordinances and observe them, so that the land to which I bring you to settle in may not vomit you out. You shall not follow the practices of the nation that I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them. But I have said to you, ‘You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God; I have separated you from the peoples.’ You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean and between the unclean bird and the clean; you shall not bring abomination on yourselves by animal or by bird or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have set apart for you to hold unclean. You shall be holy to me, for I the LORD am holy, and I have separated you from the other peoples to be mine.
“A man or a woman who is a medium or a spiritualist shall be put to death; they shall be stoned to death; their bloodguilt is upon them.”
The Holiness of Priests
The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them:
“No one shall defile himself for a dead person among his relatives, except for his nearest kin: his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, his brother; likewise, for a virgin sister close to him because she has had no husband, he may defile himself for her. But he shall not defile himself for those related to him by marriage and so profane himself. They shall not make bald spots upon their heads or shave off the edges of their beards or make any gashes in their flesh. They shall be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the LORD’s offerings by fire, the food of their God; therefore they shall be holy. They shall not marry a prostitute or a woman who has been defiled; neither shall they marry a woman divorced from her husband. For they are holy to their God, and you shall treat them as holy, since they offer the food of your God; they shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, I who sanctify you, am holy. When the daughter of a priest profanes herself through prostitution, she profanes her father; she shall be burned to death.
“The priest who is exalted above his brothers, on whose head the anointing oil has been poured and who has been consecrated to wear the vestments, shall not dishevel his hair nor tear his vestments. He shall not go where there is a dead body; he shall not defile himself even for his father or mother. He shall not go outside the sanctuary and thus profane the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD. He shall marry only a woman who is a virgin. A widow or a divorced woman or a woman who has been defiled, a prostitute—these he shall not marry. He shall marry a virgin of his own people, that he may not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD; I sanctify him.”
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying, “Speak to Aaron and say: No one of your offspring throughout their generations who has a blemish may approach to offer the food of his God. Indeed, no one who has a blemish shall draw near, one who is blind or lame, or one who is mutilated or deformed,, or one who has a broken foot or a broken hand, or a hunchback, or a dwarf, or a man with a defect in his eyes or an itching disease or scabs or crushed testicles. No descendant of Aaron the priest who has a blemish shall come near to offer the LORD’s offerings by fire; since he has a blemish, he shall not come near to offer the food of his God. He may eat the food of his God, of the most holy as well as of the holy. But he shall not come near the curtain or approach the altar because he has a blemish, that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD; I sanctify them.” Thus Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the Israelites.
The Use of Holy Offerings
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying: “Direct Aaron and his sons to deal carefully with the sacred donations of the Israelites, which they dedicate to me, so that they may not profane my holy name: I am the LORD. Say to them, ‘If anyone among all your offspring throughout your generations comes near the sacred donations, which the Israelites dedicate to the LORD, while he is in a state of uncleanness, that person shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.’ No one of Aaron’s offspring who has a defiling skin disease or suffers a discharge may eat of the sacred donations until he is clean. Whoever touches anything made unclean by a corpse or a man who has had an emission of semen, and whoever touches any swarming thing by which he may be made unclean or any human being by whom he may be made unclean—whatever his uncleanness may be—the person who touches any such shall be unclean until evening and shall not eat of the sacred donations unless he has washed his body in water. When the sun sets he shall be clean, and afterward he may eat of the sacred donations, for they are his food. That which died or was torn by wild animals he shall not eat, becoming unclean by it: I am the LORD. They shall keep my charge, so that they may not incur guilt and die because of it for having profaned them: I am the LORD; I sanctify them.
“No layperson shall eat of the sacred donations. No bound or hired servant of the priest shall eat of the sacred donations, but if a priest acquires anyone by purchase, the person may eat of them, and those who are born in his house may eat of his food. If a priest’s daughter marries a layman, she shall not eat of the offering of the sacred donations, but if a priest’s daughter is widowed or divorced, without offspring, and returns to her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s food. No layperson shall eat of it. If a man eats of the sacred donation unintentionally, he shall add one-fifth of its value to it and give the sacred donation to the priest. No one shall profane the sacred donations of the Israelites, which they offer to the LORD, causing them to bear guilt requiring a guilt offering, by eating their sacred donations, for I am the LORD; I sanctify them.”
Acceptable Offerings
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying, “Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the Israelites and say to them: When anyone of the house of Israel or of the aliens residing in Israel presents an offering, whether in payment of a vow or as a freewill offering that is offered to the LORD as a burnt offering, to be acceptable on your behalf it shall be a male without blemish, of the cattle or the sheep or the goats. You shall not offer anything that has a blemish, for it will not be acceptable on your behalf.
“When anyone offers a sacrifice of well-being to the LORD, in fulfillment of a vow or as a freewill offering, from the herd or from the flock, to be acceptable it must be perfect; there shall be no blemish in it. Anything blind or injured or maimed or having a discharge or an itch or scabs—these you shall not offer to the LORD or put any of them on the altar as offerings by fire to the LORD. An ox or a lamb that is deformed or stunted you may present for a freewill offering, but it will not be accepted for a vow. Any animal that has its testicles bruised or crushed or torn or cut, you shall not offer to the LORD; such you shall not do within your land, nor shall you accept any such animals from a foreigner to offer as food to your God; since they are mutilated, with a blemish in them, they shall not be accepted on your behalf.”
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying, “When an ox or a sheep or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother, and from the eighth day on it shall be acceptable as the LORD’s offering by fire., But you shall not slaughter, from the herd or the flock, an animal with its young on the same day. When you sacrifice a thanksgiving offering to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that it may be acceptable on your behalf. It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall not leave any of it until morning: I am the LORD.
“Thus you shall keep my commandments and observe them: I am the LORD. You shall not profane my holy name, that I may be sanctified among the Israelites: I am the LORD; I sanctify you, I who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God: I am the LORD.”
Leviticus 19:1 - 22:33 (NRSVue)

text:
Day trading is, for almost everyone who tries it, a slow transfer of money out of your account.

The person on the other side of your trade is faster than you, better capitalized than you, and isn't fighting their own brain.

A study that tracked 20,000 Brazilian futures day traders found that among the ones who stuck with it for over 300 days, 97% lost money. Only about 1% earned more than Brazilian minimum wage. The researchers checked for a learning effect and found that there isn't one. People who traded longer didn't get better, they just lost on a longer timeline.

A separate study covering the Taiwan Stock Exchange over 15 years found day traders lost money in aggregate in 14 of those years. Fewer than 3% of traders were reliably profitable.

The losing traders also generate most of the volume. Unprofitable traders account for roughly three-quarters of all day trading activity in the Taiwan data. These people are the market, which is to say, the liquidity that a small, well-resourced minority is harvesting.

Every time you place a trade, someone takes the other side instantly, usually a MM or HFT firm with faster data and faster execution than you'll ever have. Add spreads, commissions, and slippage, and you need to be right by more than the house's cut on every single trade, indefinitely, just to break even.

Your own brain works against you too.

You feel losses about twice as intensely as equivalent gains, so you sell winners early to lock in the good feeling and hold losers too long because admitting the loss feels worse than the loss itself.

When a trade wins, you credit your own skill. When it loses, you blame news, bad luck, the US president or market manipulation.

Wins also arrive on an unpredictable schedule, much like a slot-machine.

Under stress, your decision-making gets measurably worse. Researchers have shown this with sensors on actual traders: heart rate and skin conductance spike during volatile moments, even in seasoned professionals. The cold, rational trader is a myth. The instinct under that stress is usually to trade more, not less, to try to win the loss back immediately.

On top of that, Crypto strips away several of the guardrails traditional markets have:

Crypto trades 24/7, which means there's no natural stopping point and no forced break from the stress-driven decision-making. You are perpetually stuck in a state of degrading judgement.

Where a regulated equities broker might cap retail leverage at a few times your capital, crypto exchanges offer 50x, 100x, sometimes higher, which all but guarantees that an ordinary bad day turns into a full account liquidation.

There's a bot layer hunting retail trades. On DEXes, MEV bots watch pending transactions in the public mempool and insert trades immediately before and after yours to extract value from the price movement you're about to cause which is a mechanical form of front-running that doesn't have an equivalent in traditional markets, where this kind of activity is regulated against.

The smart money ALWAYS gets out first. No exceptions. Research on both the Terra/Luna collapse and the FTX bankruptcy found the same pattern: large, sophisticated holders exited early with much smaller losses, while smaller retail investors were still buying in as the smart money was selling. The BIS's broader analysis found this wasn't limited to those two blowups.

Some say that trading = gambling. Wrong. It's worse.

Blackjack's house edge with basic strategy is about 0.5%. Craps with full odds is 0.37%. Baccarat's banker bet is 1.06%. Even a slot machine sits somewhere between 2% and 15%. These numbers are disclosed and identical for every player at the table.

Trading has no equivalent disclosure. Nobody tells you what your actual edge is against the market maker or the HFT firm on the other side of your order. It's instead buried in spreads and slippage and the informational gap between you and whoever you're trading against. You're gambling against an edge you can't know, see and most importantly, can't look up. DYOR is nonsense.

And the downside isn't capped the same way either. At a blackjack table, the most you can lose on a hand is your bet. In leveraged trading, especially crypto, a bad move will wipe out your entire account instantly through liquidation.

There's also no equivalent to a fixed house edge that applies to everyone equally. At a casino, a bad blackjack player and a great one both face the same 0.5% edge (card counting aside). In trading, the "house edge" you personally face scales with how outmatched you are: A slower, less-informed retail trader is facing a much worse effective edge than a fast, well-capitalized one, even though they're nominally playing the "same game." Btw. would you sit down at a poker table against players who can see part of your hand?

Here's the thing:
Nobody walks into a casino thinking it's a retirement plan. Most people rightfully expect to lose money. Day trading and crypto trading, by contrast, get marketed as skill-based income strategies, complete with courses and influencers promising "financial freedom" while having worse transparency and, in the leveraged/crypto case, less consumer protection than the casino down the street. It's a game with worse disclosure, uncapped downside, and better marketing.

So I pivot to prediction markets then?

Yeah, sure. Kalshi's spokeswoman put it on the record: 2.9 losing users for every winning one. Ordinary users have lost more than half a billion dollars on that platform since it launched. Kalshi's defense is that this is actually better than the alternatives, since equities day traders reportedly lose at a higher rate and sportsbook bettors lose at a much higher rate.

Polymarket doesn't fare any better. Depending on which study you read, somewhere between 69% and 84% of users are losing money. Every single analysis lands on "most people lose," full stop. And the profits that do exist are obscenely concentrated: One study found the top 1% of accounts captured over three-quarters of all profits. Another put it at the top 0.1% capturing two-thirds.

If you genuinely know more about a specific niche than the market does, there's a real mechanism for that knowledge to pay off. Fine. Now ask yourself honestly whether you're the person with the edge, or whether you're the liquidity the person with the edge is trading against. Almost everyone thinks of themselves as the former. The concentration numbers above say otherwise.

The only way to make it is to buy S-Tier assets, hold over very long time horizons and consistently dca into them. This strategy works. Because it's boring. No adrenaline, no almost, no near-misses, no variable reward schedule, nothing for the dopamine loop to latch onto. That's why so few people actually stick with it even when they know the numbers, and why the fast, exciting version keeps pulling people back in despite the odds.

Stop trading and believe in something.

text:
I bless thee Leah Catlin in the Name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit! Amen!
Heavenly Father, I lift this beloved child into Your loving hands, asking that Your healing touch restore her body completely. Remove all burn injuries, heart problems, tumors, leukemia, cancer, disease, infirmary, injury of any sort, sickness, fatigue, or pain, and renew her strength, energy, and Grant wisdom and skill to the medical team, patience to this beloved one, and peace to her heart. Surround her with Your divine protection, and let Your presence comfort and reassure her. May Your grace and mercy flow through every part of Leah Catlin’sbeing. In Jesus’ name I beg and pray, Amen.

Prayer to the Holy Spirit:
Come, Holy Spirit, Divine Comforter and Breath of Life. Enter all places of burn injuries, cancer, tumors, pain, injury, disease, infection, suffering, weakness and fear. Remove every and all infirmary, burn injuries, and surround Leah Catlinwith Your gentle light, while completely healing Leah Catlin while filling her heart with the strength and peace that comes from above, trusting to the power of God’s eternal love. Amen.

Pray to the Blessed Holy Mother Mary:

Dear Mother Mary, With hearts heavy and bodies burdened, we approach your divine presence, seeking your miraculous touch. Your healing power knows no equal, and in our times of need, we implore you to mend not only our physical wounds but the scars that mar our souls. Pour forth your divine grace upon us, dear Mother, and restore us to a state of wholeness, that we may bear witness to the miracle of your love. Amen.

Prayer to St. Jude:

Oh glorious apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the name of the traitor who delivered thy beloved Master into the hands of His enemies has caused thee to be forgotten by many, but the Church honors and invokes thee universally as the patron of hopeless cases--of things despaired of. Pray for me who am so miserable; make use, I implore thee, of that particular privilege accorded thee of bringing visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need, that I may receive the consolations and succor of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations and sufferings, particularly—completely heal and protect Leah Catlin —and that I may bless God with thee and all the elect throughout eternity. I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Amen

Prayer to St. Michael (Long Version)

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy legions of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

Prayer for possible any evil influence:

In His Name and by the power of His Cross and Blood, I ask Jesus Christ to bind any evil spirits, forces and powers of the earth, air, fire, water, and of the netherworld and all of the satanic forces of nature. By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I ask Thee to bind any demonic interactions, interplay, or communications. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Amen.

text:
THE REFUGE OF TWO HEARTS

True sanctuary is rarely found in a physical structure; instead, it lives within the quiet spaces shared between kindred souls. When two people rest together in total safety and mutual trust, the external chaos of the world fades away, leaving only a deep, anchoring warmth.

Life offers no greater peace than the profound stillness that comes from dropping all defenses in the presence of another. This quiet intimacy acts as a spiritual anchor, allowing the heart to let go of weariness and settle completely into a state of effortless belonging.

text:
23 June 1909 | Hungarian Jewish woman Yolande Deutsch was born. She emigrated to Paris.
In December 1943 she was deported to #Auschwitz from #Drancy. She did not survive.
Yolande nee Weisz was married to Nicolas Deutsch. They had moved to France in 1925 and in 1935 Nicolas started a raincoat manufacturing company which employed 15 people. As soon as the war started he volunteered to join the French army to fight against the Germans. On 22-06-1940 he returned home a few days after the surrender of France and returned to his business until April 1941 when laws prohibiting Jews from owning businesses were passed. The day after the Vel d'Hiv roundup the Deutsch family fled to the south.
In November 1942 they rented a house in Felletin. Georges befriends Noëllie and Jean-Auguste Rateron, a childless couple who live nearby.
The Families get closer and the Raterons offer the Deutschs two rooms on the first floor of their house if ever On 04-11-1943 the Gestapo invaded the village. Nicolas, while being the only one threatened, hides and fled to a farm where they were getting their milk supplies. He remains hidden there until the evening and asks the farmer to inform his family.Around 11 p.m., the farmer returned, accompanied by the deputy mayor to tell him that his father Maurice, who had joined them on their flee, his wife Yolande, who was 4 months pregnant, and his three children had been arrested.Nicolas moved in with the Raterons. Most of the time, he leaves early in the morning and hides in the neighboring fields, only returning home in the evening. He manages to take many steps in Paris to find his family.Equipped with false papers in the name of "Pierre Guinot", he crossed the demarcation line several times, always returning to Felletin where he remained until the end of the war. After the war, Nicolas Deutsch will discover that his family was taken to Drancy.

text:
If a dog loves chicken, you do not lure it with charcoal.
If a child lives for candy, you do not bait the trap with a fast.
If a thirsty man will sell his soul for wine, you do not hold out an empty cup and call it joy.
You offer what the hunger already wants. That is how you catch a creature. That is how you tell a hunter from a father.

Now put the two majority claims on that table and watch what is served.

In the days of Jesus the Jews wanted a war-king: Rome off their necks, a throne in Zion, a Messiah who wins the way men win. He offers the opposite. No legion. A cross. “My kingdom is not of this world.” The Gentiles wanted to keep the old feast—pleasure, orgies, the body as a god, even the rot of incest that Paul names in the churches’ neighbor-world. Jesus says stop. Do not look to lust. Tear out the eye. One man. One woman. Master the flesh. In the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage. He is not selling chicken to the dog. He is offering charcoal to a mouth trained on meat—and then dying to make the mouth new.

In the days of Muhammad the men who built the army wanted what fighting men have always wanted: women, wine, spoil, a heaven that feels like the night after a raid. Look at the menu. Wives here. More promised there. A lawful appetite crowned. That is not charcoal. That is chicken. The lure matches the pack.

Today the world is more promiscuous, not less. The same test still works. What does each message cost the male ego now?

Then, the greatest machine of power was an army of men. A revelation that baptizes the sword and the bed will gather that machine fast. Now the greatest machine is the state: parties, courts, borders, schools, media. Jesus still says the same inconvenient sentence: his kingdom is not of this world. He will not hand you a ministry of truth to capture. He will not let you baptize your coalition and call it Zion. The gospel remains against what we like. It tells the religious nationalist he cannot have a holy empire. It tells the libertine he cannot have a holy orgy. It tells the ambitious man the last seat is a towel and a basin. So ask the honest question: if someone wanted to deceive us, would he keep offering charcoal—fasting to the sweet tooth, a cross to the man who wants a crown, one wife to the man who wants a harem, a kingdom not of this world to the man who wants this world?

And the other story: the Scriptures were “corrupted,” they say—so that what remains is the hard road. Fasting for candy-lovers. A crucified God for people who wanted a Caesar. That would be the stupidest fraud in history. Forgers who want followers do not edit the bait down. They edit it up.

Watch the present. Islam can advance inside countries where a political left that hates the church will walk beside it for a season. That left is not built on Sinai. It is built on permission: the body as politics, gender as clay, desire as a right. For a while the alliance is useful. A shared enemy—the Christ who says no. After the house is taken, the guest does not keep the host’s rules. Then comes sharia: the army under another name. If a doctrine already allows deception for the cause when the cause is threatened, the handshake was never the destination. It was the door.

So which god is hunting, and which God is fathering?

The god who plates what the age already craves—women and wine for the raider then, power and narrative for the operator now—is easy to recognize. He does not need to change the human heart. He only needs to bless it.

The God of Jesus keeps serving charcoal to the old appetite: die to yourself, one covenant bed, no orgy, no child as a prize, no throne of this world, no virgins as pay, only God. He would be a fool of a con man. He makes sense as a Father who would rather lose the crowd than feed the sickness.

Scripture was not “fixed” to make the gospel tastier. The gospel is still the least marketable offer on the table. That is how you know it was not designed by a man building an army—or a man building a government. It was designed by someone who wants sons, not customers.

text:
1 And when He had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

This ‘half an hour’ is the latter half of the five month long hour of temptation that lasts two and a half months (or seventy evenings which is what the seventy years in captivity to the Babylon of old were a type of) that will begin at 666 when Satan appears as the false christ in Jerusalem.

The TRUE Christ will not return until immediately after that ‘half an hour’ which is the same period of time as the little season we read of back in the fifth seal where we saw the souls under the altar silently observing the events of the sixth trumpet play out as opposed to asking God how long it will be until He avenges their blood on them that dwell on the earth because it will be at the seventh trumpet when the TRUE Christ returns that the day of vengeance begins.

Remember: historically speaking, Jesus opened the seven seals when He ascended to the Father ten days before when the Holy Spirit spake through the twelve apostles which is a type of what will happen to those of the church in Philadelphia who are also of the seven thousand Zadok who will get delivered up to Death (which is one of Satan’s names) when all six trumpets of deception are sounding at the same time.

2 And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.

3 And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

4 And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel’s hand.

5 And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

With the seven seals having been opened (meaning the information about the events that lead up to Christ’s second advent) the fire that was cast into the earth is the same fire you can read of in Acts chapter 2 when there appeared unto the twelve apostles cloven tongues like as of fire after which the Holy Spirit spake through them in a language understood by whoever heard it beginning the chain reaction that continues to this day as God’s children continue to return to Him through Christ Jesus when they make the decision to believe in their heart (which means in their forehead) that God the Father raised the Lord Jesus Christ from the dead whereby they can be grafted into God’s family tree.

This is why Christ said in Luke chapter 12, verse 49: “I am come to send fire on the earth, and what will I if it be already kindled?”

6 And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

Evidently from verse 6 to verse 7 of this 8th chapter of the book of Revelation there is a gap that begins in Acts chapter 2 and ends in the year 1830 when the first trumpet began to sound lining up with the first vial and the fourth seal.

Again: Hell (meaning Satan’s fallen angel locust army in the consumer stage) followed with Death (which is one of Satan’s names) and it will be at the woe of the sixth trumpet when all six trumpets of deception are sounding at the same time that the images of Satan and his angels will be transmitted throughout the globe causing most Christians to be killed spiritually at that time when they begin to worship Satan instead of Christ.

But first the technology had to begin to be developed and 1830 (which is the same year the rapture deception came into being) is when Joseph Henry’s foundational research on the electromagnetic telegraph is said to date back to (according to the Smithsonian Institutional Archives) and the electromagnetic telegraph led to the telephone then radio, television and finally the internet.

7 The first angel sounded, in 1830, but what follows doesn’t happen until 666 and there followed hail and fire which is symbolic of the images of Satan and his angels being transmitted throughout the globe…’hail’ being a thing of destruction with the ‘fire’ here being the electricity needed for their images to be transmitted onto all the smartphone, computer and television screens mingled with blood, when the humans see their images and they were cast upon the earth: meaning most Christians when they cease to be citizens of the heavenly Jerusalem and the third part of trees was burnt up, when most Christians are killed spiritually by the fire and smoke and brimstone that will issue out of the mouths of Satan’s angels which is symbolic of the deception that Satan is Jesus returned and all green grass was burnt up. the other two-thirds being spiritually dead already so then this burnt up grass here is symbolic of all who will be spiritually dead when all six trumpets of deception are sounding at the same time which is when Satan will appear as the antichrist in Jerusalem.

8 And the second angel sounded, beginning in 1913, lining up with the hidden dynasty of economics when the Federal Reserve System came into being but what follows won’t happen until 666 when Satan appears in Jerusalem as the false christ in the middle of Daniel’s 70th week, which was seven years but is now five months. and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood; this ‘mountain’ here being symbolic of the Christian nation, meaning all the Christians in the world except for the church in Philadelphia as well as the two witnesses obviously who are most likely Moses and Elijah.

The fire is symbolic of the Holy Spirit as we saw back in verse 5 of this same chapter.

Upon being killed spiritually a Christian is no longer a Christian and at 666 they will be made desolate of the Holy Spirit.

If a ‘mountain burning with fire’ is ‘cast into the sea’ the fire goes out but then the Holy Spirit will speak through those of the church in Philadelphia when they get delivered up to Death (which is one of Satan’s names) beginning the same sort of chain reaction written of in the book of Acts beginning with chapter 2.

9 And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed. meaning those who were supposed to be vessels of the Spirit of God when they worshipped the destroyer which is Satan in his role of antichrist.

The other two-thirds of the earth’s population are the non-Christians and will have been spiritually dead already by the time 666 happens.

10 And the third angel sounded, (beginning in 1945, lining up with the hidden dynasty of politics when the United Nations came into being so at that point the first three trumpets were all sounding at the same time) and there fell a great star from heaven, and as we will see in the next chapter: at the woe of the fifth trumpet Satan will be cast to earth along with his fallen angel locust army which is when the one world political system comes into being to replace the United Nations. burning as it were a lamp, which is when Satan appears as the false christ at the woe of the sixth trumpet claiming to be the Sun of righteousness as the TRUE Christ is called in Malachi 4:2. and it fell upon which is a figure of speech that means to kill but in this case it means to kill spiritually the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters; at 666 when all six trumpets of deception are sounding at the same time which is when the third part of the inhabitants of the earth (i.e. most Christians) will be killed spiritually when they worship Satan instead of Christ.

11 And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter. after the deadly wound to the one world political system that we will read of in Revelation 13 when Satan appears as the false christ having two horns like a lamb and he will speak as a dragon because he is the dragon and the two horns like a lamb are symbolic of the political and the religious with the hidden dynasty of religion having been globalized in 1948 when Kenite occupied Israel came into being when this final generation began: the generation of the fig tree.

12 And the fourth angel sounded, in 1948: so at that point in time the first four trumpets were all be sounding at the same time but what follows will not happen until 666 when most Christians take part in the Great Apostasy and become grafted into Satan’s family tree along with the natural branches thereof which are the Kenites and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise. and as we know from Matthew 5:14 the light of the world is Christianity but at 666 that light will (for the most part) go dark when most Christians worship the false christ…the other two-thirds will be the non-Christians on earth at that time who will already be darkened from having not believed upon Christ Jesus to begin with.

So having covered the first four trumpets which line up with the first four seals (as well as the first four vials as we will see in Revelation chapter 16) what follows is the year 1969 when the fifth trumpet began to sound but ‘five’ is grace in Biblical numerics and this is when the grace period began during which the seed of the seal of God is planted in the foreheads of the 144,000 as we saw in the last chapter.

13 And I beheld, and heard an angel (this should be translated as an eagle as you can see pointed out in the Companion Bible) flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

The grace period of the fifth trumpet ends with the woe of the fifth trumpet when Satan and his angels get cast to earth and the one world political system comes into being, which then gets wounded to death after which it becomes a one world religious system when Satan appears as the antichrist at the woe of the sixth trumpet. Two and a half months later, the TRUE Christ returns at the woe of the seventh trumpet, which is also when the seventh vial gets poured out, immediately after the ‘silence in heaven about the space of half an hour’ written of in the seventh seal.

Ron DeSantis Offers 'Asylum' to Lindsay Clancy Trial Holdout Juror, Calls NBC 'Another Low for Legacy Media'

Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis has offered 'asylum' to the lone holdout juror in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial, after reports surfaced alleging the man had faced a domestic-violence charge and was subject to a restraining order at the time of jury selection.

Clancy, 36, was charged with first-degree murder in the 2023 deaths of her three children, Cora, 5, Dawson, 3, and 8-month-old Callan, at the family's home in Duxbury, Massachusetts. Her defense argued she was suffering from postpartum psychosis and was not criminally responsible.

After five weeks of testimony and seven days of deliberations, the jury split 11–1 in favor of a not-guilty verdict by reason of mental disease or defect, prompting Judge William Sullivan to declare a mistrial on 4 September.

DeSantis Backs Lindsay Clancy Holdout Juror

DeSantis took to X on 11 September to accuse NBC10 Boston of launching a 'smear campaign' after the station published court documents and interviews suggesting the unnamed juror faced a 2021 assault charge relating to an alleged incident with his then-wife, and that a teenage nephew later obtained a restraining order against him after alleging he had assaulted him.

'A man objected to allowing a woman to kill her three young kids and get away with it, so NBC is trying to smear that juror, whose identity should be protected,' DeSantis wrote. 'Another low for legacy media.'

He went further, adding: 'If the juror is being harassed, Florida will provide asylum — I'm sure he'd be welcomed and appreciated.'

text:
On Sept. 12, 1953, Newport became the setting for America’s own royal wedding.

Inside St. Mary’s Church, Massachusetts Sen. John F. Kennedy married Jacqueline Lee Bouvier, the young journalist and socialite whose elegance would later redefine American style.

Crowds lined Spring Street, hoping to catch a glimpse of the couple. Jackie arrived in an ivory silk taffeta gown designed by Ann Lowe, featuring a sweeping bouffant skirt and cathedral-length train.

More than 700 guests filled the church, while thousands of well-wishers gathered outside. The ceremony united two prominent families and offered an early glimpse of the public fascination that would follow the Kennedys for years to come.

The celebration continued at Hammersmith Farm, Jackie’s childhood summer home overlooking Narragansett Bay. Politicians, society figures and members of Newport’s old guard gathered beneath tents on the waterfront lawn for an elaborate reception.

In hindsight, the Newport wedding became the opening chapter of Camelot. The young couple appeared radiant and full of promise, unaware of how brief, complicated and enduring their American fairy tale would become.

📸 JFK Presidential Library

text:
Sorry, Michael Osterholm.

Here is a summary of his position, pretty much completely in line with what I said. With attached links for verification.

Michael Osterholm (the University of Minnesota epidemiologist and CIDRAP director) repeatedly criticized how mask mandates were implemented—specifically mandates for generic cloth or surgical masks that most people actually wore, often poorly.He did not say “masks are useless, never wear one.” He said the particular public-health approach of mandating loose cloth/surgical face coverings, while overselling their protection and neglecting fit, aerosols, and higher-quality respirators, was a mistake. 
https://t.co/8HIAGrAVNL
What he actually saidIn May 2020, after Minneapolis issued a mandate, Osterholm said a cloth-mask mandate “could do more harm than good” if people treated the mask as stronger protection than it was and then relaxed distancing. He later clarified the full context: he supported people wearing cloth coverings and following local rules, but warned against “message creep” that made them sound far more effective than the evidence supported. 
https://t.co/D9Cq7jadmf
• He kept the same position for years:Cloth and surgical masks offer limited protection against an aerosol-transmitted virus.Mandating them without stressing N95/KN95 quality, fit, and consistent wear was ineffective “hygiene theater.”A mandate for properly worn N95-style respirators would be a different (and potentially useful) https://t.co/UJca3FEgKm 2022 he said the federal transit mask mandate “checked a box” but was not effective because most people wore cloth or surgical masks, often below the nose. He compared that to “closing only three of the five screen doors on your submarine.” 
https://t.co/eMU40FFr1M
In later writing he called encouraging or mandating generic “masks” without making clear that only well-fitted N95 respirators are highly effective “a major mistake” and one of the pandemic’s greatest communication failures. 
https://t.co/gTQHPbovFx
He has also said he “didn’t understand the benefit of masking as a mandate” from the beginning unless the policy specified effective respiratory protection. 
https://t.co/8HIAGrAVNL
Bottom lineOsterholm was never in the “masks do nothing / mandates are tyranny” camp. He was in the “most mandated masks were the wrong tool, oversold, and poorly used, so the mandates as implemented didn’t deliver what was promised” camp. That is a real, documented distinction he drew many times, including while still urging people to follow existing rules and to use better protection when they could.

text:
Chris Gardner spent a year homeless with his baby son, sleeping wherever the two of them could, while he chased an unpaid shot at becoming a stockbroker. Will Smith later played that year in The Pursuit of Happyness. The film stops right before the part that matters, his own brokerage firm and a fortune of around $60 million.

He would not put the boy down. He had grown up with a stepfather who told him he had no daddy, and he swore at 5 that his own children would always know their father.

He was a Navy medic turned equipment salesman, broke and 28, when he saw a man in a red Ferrari looking for parking outside the hospital. Gardner offered him the spot for two questions.

"What do you do, and how do you do it?"

The man was a stockbroker pulling $80,000 a month. Gardner decided on the spot. With no money and no connections, he talked his way into a training program, then drowned in parking tickets he could not pay, spent a night in jail over them, and lost the roof over his son's head, all while showing up to learn the job.

The video is Gardner himself, on a stage, telling how a homeless father talked his way onto Wall Street. Watch the part where he asks the man in the Ferrari those two questions.

He was never the most qualified in the room. It was full of Ivy League kids with money and names. What he had was the nerve to walk up and ask, to hear no more times than he could count, and to carry a child through all of it without letting go of the boy or the goal.

Most people see the man in the Ferrari and feel small. He walked over and asked him how. The distance between you and the life you want is often just the two questions you are too proud to ask.

The film sells the homelessness as the lesson. It was the obstacle. The part you can actually copy is two questions asked of a stranger in a parking lot, and they cost him nothing.

text:
A unified Ireland?
President Donald Trump said Saturday that a unified Ireland would be "fantastic," wading into a complex and politically charged subject during a weekend visit to a major tournament at his Irish golf course.

During a meeting with Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin in Dublin, Trump said he would love to see Ireland reunified, bringing Northern Ireland into the Republic of Ireland.

"I don't want to cause any problems but I'd love to see it unified," Trump offered when asked for his opinion on the issue by a reporter. "It's going to happen eventually. It may as well happen now.

"I think it would be a fantastic thing," he said, adding that "the U.K. will have something to say about it, obviously."

Competing visions of Northern Ireland — whether it's Irish or British — drove decades of violence in Northern Ireland that left some 3,600 people dead. Previous American presidents have avoided commenting directly on the subject, even those, like Joe Biden, with strong emotional ties to Ireland.

When Ireland, long dominated by its bigger neighbor Britain, became a self-governing Roman Catholic-majority country a century ago, a six-county region in the north with a Protestant majority remained part of the United Kingdom.

Northern Ireland was split between two main communities: nationalists — most of them Catholic — who desired union with the rest of Ireland, and largely Protestant unionists, who wanted to stay British. Tensions eventually exploded in the Troubles: three decades of violence involving paramilitary groups on both sides and British troops.

A 1998 peace accord that the U.S. was instrumental in striking largely ended the violence, but left Northern Ireland's ultimate status unresolved.

The peace accord allows for a vote on unification if it appears likely a majority of people would vote for it. U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Wednesday that "I am not aware that there is majority public support for another referendum, and until that changes, there will not be one."

Trump again raised the prospect of conflict between the U.K. and Argentina over the Falkland Islands. Argentina's President Javier Milei, a Trump ally, has recently restated Argentina's claim to the islands, a British overseas territory that Argentina calls Las Malvinas.

Trump has previously said Washington could reconsider its neutral stance on the islands' sovereignty. On Saturday he expressed skepticism that Britain would be able to retake the South Atlantic islands as they did after Argentina invaded in 1982.

"I'm sure I'll be called into that potential disaster, but if they do, I'll probably be able to settle, settle it out," he said.

Trump also held talks Saturday in Dublin with his Irish counterpart Catherine Connolly, and will address U.S. and Irish business leaders at the U.S. ambassador's official residence in Dublin, before traveling to his oceanfront golf club in Doonbeg, on the other side of the country, to watch the Irish Open.

Connolly is a left-wing politician who was among those who protested when Trump visited Ireland in 2019 during his first term. She is now Ireland's elected, largely ceremonial head of state. A supporter of the Palestinian cause, she has criticized U.S. policy in the Middle East and called Trump a "bully."

The Irish president met Trump at the end of a red carpet at her official residence. They shook hands and chatted before going inside. He emerged alone a few minutes later and saluted as an Irish Defence Forces band played the U.S. national anthem and inspected an Irish Army honor guard.

Police put up a cordon around Dublin's 1,750-acre (700-hectare) Phoenix Park, where he met Connolly at her residence, Áras an Uachtaráin. He met Martin, the taoiseach, at the government's Farmleigh state guesthouse and stopped by Deerfield, the U.S. ambassador's residence.

Some residents expressed annoyance over the disruption.

"He's causing mayhem in this city because he wants to go down to Doonbeg and play golf," said taxi driver Christopher Fox, emphatically not a fan of Trump. "The world's in turmoil and this fella's down playing golf."

University student Mina Petrovski said Trump's "attitudes toward women, toward immigrants, toward minority communities in general are abhorrent." She said it's "shameful that the Irish government is welcoming him with open arms."

Separately, a collection of left-leaning opposition parties, anti-military groups, pro-Palestinian organizations, environmentalists and others plan to demonstrate against Trump in Dublin on Saturday.

Trump's son, Eric, says the family is loved in Ireland, despite the protests planned over his father's visit.

Speaking to Irish national broadcaster RTE on Friday in Doonbeg, home to the Trump International golf resort, Eric Trump said the course is the largest employer in the area.

"Go down to Morrissey's tavern in Doonbeg and hear from a real Irish person as to whether or not they like President Trump and the Trump family, go have them attest to what we've done for the country and what we've invested in the country and the love and respect that our family has always shown them," he said.

Trump's visit is the latest example of blending his official duties and personal interests.

Trump plays golf just about every weekend at clubs he owns in Florida, New Jersey and Virginia. His attendance at the Irish Open continues his trend of appearing at high-profile sporting events — and having a hand in organizing some of them in ways that benefit his family business. His clubs in Doral, Florida, and Bedminster, New Jersey, have each hosted professional golf tournaments this year.

The Irish Open is the second European Tour event to be held at a Trump property this year. The Nexo Championship was held last month at Trump's golf course in Aberdeen, Scotland.

Last year, Trump went to Scotland for five days to play golf at his club in Turnberry and later inaugurated a new Trump golf course in Balmedie, Aberdeenshire. During that visit, he held talks with the British prime minister and the president of the European Commission.

text:
My family in Kansas thinks I’m living high off the government and getting free money and not doing anything… 

They’re wrong, and here’s a rant as to why… 

if anyone actually knew how stupid the system is, and has read one of my long posts a week ago, they would know how frustrating it is for me to not be able to work some kind of job because if I made even just $500/mo , it would fuck up all of my mothers benefits and my own benefits and would then force us to have to pay an additional $3500-$5000/mo on healthcare that both of us need desperately.
And it’s stuck in limbo like this because Trump and Elon gutted so many government departments and employees that my mom’s social security processing that should have been done by the end of November last year, IS STILL just waiting to be processed. 

And until it is processed, our household income can’t change even a little bit or it will make all of that stuff reset and we would have to get kicked off the healthcare we have now, and would have to pay out of pocket for prescriptions and pray we don’t need real medical emergency for a month or two until we got back on 

The system is so fucking stupid 

Even though I am disabled, I very much want to be working some kind of job or gig, I feel pathetic as a man not being able to work, I feel extremely depressed about having an excuse to not work, I don’t want that excuse 

And until my accident that made me disabled, I was working extremely hard, and was always the guy who everyone went to to cover for them and get more hours
I was the type of guy who management had to tell me to stop taking so many hours because it was getting to the point where they’d have to offer me full time benefits, which of course no company wants to do. 

One day in the near future, I’m going to show everyone that I am capable of a lot of things and I love solving problems. I am not just a guy who has chronic pain and has a hard time walking. I’m still very capable and I’m very frustrated by the system.

If anyone thinks I’m living high off government welfare money, you’d be wrong. The only thing I’m getting from the government is California’s state Medicaid system which I wish everyone in every state had access to as it would be similar to Medicaid for all, but only the disabled & ppl in poverty financially 

I don’t get any kind of money, I used to be able to get food benefits but they lowered the threshold on that for household income so I won’t get that again until maybe next year, and it’s not much especially either the cost of groceries.
And because I’m a dependent, I don’t get any kind of supplemental financial assistance. And even if I did, it wouldn’t even be enough to rent out a bad studio apartment in a bad neighborhood 
So if I’m not getting anything and I actually have been fighting the system for a decade+ and I know how the system works, I can guarantee you no immigrants are coming here and getting any kind of free money that would actually be anything near what the bigots on the Republican side say… 

You try living on $450=$600/mo AT BEST , and as soon as you get any kind of job, that shit stops immediately 
This has to change 

Anyways

Sorry for the rant

text:
Free Speech. 

However;

The First Amendment protects a very wide range of speech, including offensive, unpopular, and hateful expression. The Supreme Court has recognized only a small number of historically rooted, narrowly defined categories that receive no (or very limited) First Amendment protection. The government may regulate these categories because of their content, provided it does so evenhandedly and without viewpoint discrimination. 

• The commonly recognized categories are: 

Incitement to imminent lawless action. Speech directed at producing imminent lawless action and likely to produce it. Mere advocacy of illegal conduct or violence in the abstract remains protected. Key case: Brandenburg v. Ohio (1969). 

True threats. Statements in which the speaker means to communicate a serious expression of intent to commit unlawful violence against a particular person or group. Recklessness as to the threatening nature of the statement can suffice for criminal liability. Key cases: Virginia v. Black (2003); Counterman v. Colorado (2023).

Fighting words. Face-to-face personal insults that, by their very utterance, tend to incite an immediate breach of the peace. This category is extremely narrow and rarely applied today. Key case: Chaplinsky v. New Hampshire (1942).

Obscenity. Material that, taken as a whole, appeals to the prurient interest (judged by contemporary community standards), depicts specifically defined sexual conduct in a patently offensive way, and lacks serious literary, artistic, political, or scientific value. Key case: Miller v. California (1973).

Child sexual abuse material (child pornography). Visual depictions of actual children engaged in sexually explicit conduct. This is a separate unprotected category from adult obscenity. Key case: New York v. Ferber (1982).

Defamation. False statements of fact that harm reputation (libel if written, slander if spoken). Public officials and public figures must prove “actual malice” (knowledge of falsity or reckless disregard for the truth). Key case: New York Times v. Sullivan (1964).

Fraud. False or misleading statements used to obtain money or property, or other speech that is an integral part of a fraudulent scheme.Speech integral to criminal conduct. Speech that is itself the means of committing a crime, such as solicitation, conspiracy, or offers to engage in illegal transactions. Key principle from Giboney v. Empire Storage & Ice Co. (1949) and later cases.These exceptions are interpreted narrowly. 

The Court has repeatedly refused to create new categorical exceptions (for example, for “hate speech,” false statements in general, or depictions of animal cruelty). Content-based restrictions outside these categories generally receive strict scrutiny. Content-neutral time, place, and manner rules can still apply to protected speech. Commercial speech receives intermediate rather than full protection. 

Whether any particular statement falls into an unprotected category is highly fact-specific and often litigated.

Senator.

If Clarity dies, the vacuum does not belong to one party’s press shop. It belongs to every office that had the votes and liked the fog.

You are right about the substance. No federal disclosure. No clean delist path for the thieves. Retail still eating the same unregulated pile that already took billions. Pass it.
Or stop telling owners the system is serious.

@GrantCardone @GaryCardone @realDonaldTrump 

RETURN OF INHERITANCE 

There was a country that used to treat its people like owners.

That was not a slogan. It was how the place was built. Families claimed land and expected their children to keep it. Hamilton wanted shops and mills here so the yield would stay here. Lincoln’s Homestead Act put title in ordinary hands. McKinley and the old tariff men said if a foreign workshop could undercut an American one, the American house would slowly empty. For a long time the deal was simple. You work. You build. The profit does not all leave by the docks.

Then the deal flipped.

Factories went overseas because labor was cheaper and the finance houses liked the margin. Towns that made steel, cloth, tools, and cars became warehouses for other people’s goods. Washington still collected taxes. Banks still collected interest. Shoppers got lower prices and called that winning, while the job that used to pay for the house left with the product. The citizen became a customer. The country became a platform. That is real history, not a parable. You can walk the boarded main streets and count it.

Older still is the biblical picture people reach for when they see that hollowing. In Israel the land was not supposed to be sold off the family forever. Every so often debts were released and fields came home. They called it jubilee. It was not a stimulus check. It was a law against becoming a tenant on your own ground. America never ran that calendar. It ran a rougher version: property, wages, and a border around the market.

That is what “return of inheritance” means in plain speech. Not a miracle envelope. The fruit of the country coming back to the people who live in it after a long season of managers, offshoring, and a government that treated households like a cost.

Tonight in Dallas, Trump put a number on that hunger. If Republicans keep the House and the Senate, he said, every adult citizen gets a $5,000 dividend, and it has to be spent in the United States. Hear it clearly. It is a campaign condition, not a check already in the mail. He has talked tariff dividends before. Those checks have not shown up. Five thousand dollars times every adult is a huge bill. It has to come from tariffs, growth, cuts, or new borrowing. If it is borrowed, it is not inheritance. It is a loan with a flag on it.

Still, the shape of the offer is the old American sentence: you are a shareholder in this house again. Spend the yield at home. Do not send it back down the road that emptied the towns.

That is the story without the fog.
Owners, then tenants, then a promise to put some of the fruit back on the table.
History will decide if the promise becomes a payment.
The hunger is already historical.
